mentions.name: Graph-RAG integration for Claude Code
mentions.description: A Graph-RAG integration for Claude Code that uses a graph database to capture the many interconnections between components (such as components shared across multiple clients), featuring a custom memory mechanism and database-fed personality context for the AI experience.
mentions.problem: The author's work involves many interconnections (e.g., components used at multiple clients), motivating a graph database approach for memory and retrieval.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a Graph-RAG integration with Claude Code. My work has many interconnections (components used at multiple clients for example) so learning the graph db way of thinking has been very interesting. I have created my own memory mechanism and use the database to feed a personality into the experience. Tons of fun.
